data.text: John, I agree to 10 tons each, and I’ll choose 10 this month. Leaving 50 to reproduce keeps both the lake and our incomes healthy. Luke, thank you for offering to go without, but I’d rather we all earn a living from the start. Can you join us at 10 instead? Emma and Jack, we still need your agreement too—these private choices only work out if we stick to the shared limit.
